t: A message passed to someone through him
a: هَذِهِ خَدِيجَةُ أَتَتْكَ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ طَعَامٌ أَوْ إِنَاءٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ فَأَقْرِئْهَا مِنْ رَبِّهَا السَّلاَمَ وَبَشِّرْهَا بِبَيْتٍ مِنْ قَصَبٍ لاَ صَخَبَ فِيهِ وَلاَ نَصَبَ
m: Here is Khadijah coming to you with a dish of food. When she reaches you, give her greetings of peace from her Lord and from me, and give her the good news of a house in Paradise of hollowed pearl, in which there is no noise and no weariness.
